narration:
After one month as one life, you chose “Auto-transfer 6,000 on salary day” in month 2, and the ghost took “Save whatever is left at month end”.
In month 22, at the layoff, the ghost had 10,745 less.
The ghost's Safety ended 2 points lower, and it could last less long with no pay.
The ghost's Life ended 1 point higher, and it was a little further from only getting by.
By month 24, the ghost had 9,997 less.
